titles.title: Trees in Snow

description: A snowy winter landscape in black, white, and gray with a bare, twisted tree on the left and a tall pine tree on the right. The background is a muted, gray sky, suggesting an overcast, wintry day. A path runs diagonally from the lower left to upper right of the image.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
title: Trees in Snow
